title: AgEcon IrrigationYieldPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed agricultural economics research task on irrigation program evaluation using field-year panel data. Conducted comprehensive econometric analysis including OLS regression, quantile regression, treatment effects analysis, and policy simulation. Generated 8 visualizations and 10 output files. Produced a detailed research report (report/report.md) with methodology, results, and policy implications. Key findings: groundwater quota enforcement has strongest positive effect on yields (1.44 t/ha per unit increase), irrigation and rainfall also significant, fertilizer not statistically significant. Policy simulation shows 4.2% yield increase from strengthening enforcement.
